business_settings_region_check.name: business_settings_region_check
business_settings_region_check.value: "business_settings"."region" is null or ("business_settings"."country" is not null and "business_settings"."region" ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{1,3}$')

credit_note_lines_line_total_check.name: credit_note_lines_line_total_check
credit_note_lines_line_total_check.value:
case "credit_note_lines"."line_total_source"
      when 'computed' then ("credit_note_lines"."unit_sell" is null and "credit_note_lines"."line_total" = 0) or "credit_note_lines"."line_total" = round("credit_note_lines"."quantity" * "credit_note_lines"."unit_sell", 2)
      when 'printed' then "credit_note_lines"."line_total_reason" is not null
      else false end

credit_notes_tax_total_source_check.name: credit_notes_tax_total_source_check
credit_notes_tax_total_source_check.value: "credit_notes"."tax_total_source" in ('computed','printed') and ("credit_notes"."tax_total_source" = 'computed' or "credit_notes"."tax_total_reason" is not null)

credit_notes_issue_check.name: credit_notes_issue_check
credit_notes_issue_check.value: "credit_notes"."issue_key" is null or ("credit_notes"."issued_at" is not null and "credit_notes"."number" ~ '^CN-[0-9]{4}-([1-9]|1[0-2])-[1-9][0-9]*$')

invoice_lines_line_total_check.name: invoice_lines_line_total_check
invoice_lines_line_total_check.value:
case "invoice_lines"."line_total_source"
      when 'computed' then ("invoice_lines"."unit_sell" is null and "invoice_lines"."line_total" = 0) or "invoice_lines"."line_total" = round("invoice_lines"."quantity" * "invoice_lines"."unit_sell", 2)
      when 'printed' then "invoice_lines"."line_total_reason" is not null
      else false end

invoices_tax_total_source_check.name: invoices_tax_total_source_check
invoices_tax_total_source_check.value: "invoices"."tax_total_source" in ('computed','printed') and ("invoices"."tax_total_source" = 'computed' or "invoices"."tax_total_reason" is not null)

invoices_issue_check.name: invoices_issue_check
invoices_issue_check.value: "invoices"."issue_key" is null or ("invoices"."issued_at" is not null and "invoices"."number" ~ '^INV-[0-9]{4}-([1-9]|1[0-2])-[1-9][0-9]*$' and "invoices"."reference" is not null and btrim("invoices"."reference") <> '')

milestone_rule_caps_limit_check.name: milestone_rule_caps_limit_check
milestone_rule_caps_limit_check.value: ("milestone_rule_caps"."max_percent" is not null and "milestone_rule_caps"."max_percent" > 0 and "milestone_rule_caps"."max_percent" <= 100) or ("milestone_rule_caps"."max_amount" is not null and "milestone_rule_caps"."max_amount" > 0)

milestone_rule_milestones_share_check.name: milestone_rule_milestones_share_check
milestone_rule_milestones_share_check.value: ("milestone_rule_milestones"."percent" is not null and "milestone_rule_milestones"."percent" > 0 and "milestone_rule_milestones"."percent" <= 100) or ("milestone_rule_milestones"."amount" is not null and "milestone_rule_milestones"."amount" > 0)

milestone_rules_region_check.name: milestone_rules_region_check
milestone_rules_region_check.value: "milestone_rules"."region" is null or ("milestone_rules"."country" is not null and "milestone_rules"."region" ~ '^[A-Z0-9]{1,3}$')

payment_milestones_share_check.name: payment_milestones_share_check
payment_milestones_share_check.value: ("payment_milestones"."percent" is not null and "payment_milestones"."percent" > 0 and "payment_milestones"."percent" <= 100) or ("payment_milestones"."amount" is not null and "payment_milestones"."amount" > 0)

payments_void_check.name: payments_void_check
payments_void_check.value: "payments"."voided_at" is not null or ("payments"."void_reason" is null and "payments"."voided_by" is null)

quote_lines_line_total_check.name: quote_lines_line_total_check
quote_lines_line_total_check.value:
case "quote_lines"."line_total_source"
      when 'computed' then ("quote_lines"."unit_sell" is null and "quote_lines"."line_total" = 0) or "quote_lines"."line_total" = round("quote_lines"."quantity" * "quote_lines"."unit_sell", 2)
      when 'printed' then "quote_lines"."line_total_reason" is not null
      else false end

quotes_tax_total_source_check.name: quotes_tax_total_source_check
quotes_tax_total_source_check.value: "quotes"."tax_total_source" in ('computed','printed') and ("quotes"."tax_total_source" = 'computed' or "quotes"."tax_total_reason" is not null)

xero_connections_connected_check.name: xero_connections_connected_check
xero_connections_connected_check.value: "xero_connections"."status" <> 'connected' or ("xero_connections"."tenant_id" is not null and "xero_connections"."refresh_token_enc" is not null)

xero_invoice_syncs_created_check.name: xero_invoice_syncs_created_check
xero_invoice_syncs_created_check.value: "xero_invoice_syncs"."state" not in ('created','mismatch') or "xero_invoice_syncs"."xero_invoice_id" is not null
